name: Care Plans
headline: Website care with *a written scope*.
promise: Optional maintenance after launch: content edits, updates, backups and checks, with the tasks, the limits and the monthly price agreed in writing. It is separate from the website build and quoted to what your site needs.

included.title: Small content edits
included.text: New prices, photos or opening hours, up to the number of edits agreed in your quote, sent to us on WhatsApp.

included.title: Updates kept current
included.text: The software your site runs on, updated and checked before the change goes live.

included.title: Backups
included.text: Backups on the schedule agreed in your quote, so a broken change can be rolled back.

included.title: Uptime and SSL checks
included.text: We check that the site opens and its certificate is valid, as agreed, and tell you when something needs fixing.

included.title: Speed re-checks
included.text: We re-check page speed after content changes and fix what slows a page down, within the agreed scope.

included.title: A short monthly note
included.text: What was changed, what was checked and anything you should know, if your quote includes it.

process.text: Built by us or someone else, we look at how it is hosted and what it needs.
Tasks, number of edits, response times and the monthly price. You approve before it starts.
Access set up and a first backup taken before anything is changed.
Edits as you send them, updates and checks, within the agreed scope.

faqs.a: The notice period and terms are written in your quote before you agree. Your website, domain and content stay yours either way.

faqs.q: Do you look after sites SiteBlitz didn't build?
faqs.a: Often, yes. We check how the site is built and hosted first, then quote what is practical.

faqs.q: What counts as a content edit?
faqs.a: A change to text, prices, photos or hours on an existing page. New pages, new features or a redesign are quoted separately.

faqs.q: Is maintenance included in the website price?
faqs.a: No. The build price is one-time. Maintenance is optional and quoted separately, sized to what your site needs.

faqs.q: My site already works. Why would I need this?
faqs.a: You may not. Many small sites need only occasional edits; we will say so. Care plans suit sites that change often or must stay up.

cta: Tell us what your site needs each month, and we will reply with a written scope and price.
